data.corpus_key: Prince in Chains ~ Howl of Despair
data.description: The Prince in Chains can loose a howl of immortal agony once every 1d4 rounds. All nonevil creatures within 60 feet must succeed at a DC %1 Will saving throw or take 6d6 points of sonic damage. Any within 10 feet who fail their saves are also affected as per the Insanity spell. This is a sonic, mind-affecting effect.
